MacKay & Somps is seeking a **Junior Civil Engineer** to join our Roseville, CA office. Candidates must hold a B.S. in Civil Engineering or related field from an ABET-accredited university. EIT certification in California is highly desirable. Prior work in land development, drainage and flood control, or municipal water system design is helpful, but not required. This is a great opportunity for candidates interested in land development and/or public infrastructure design to gain experience working alongside a seasoned team of engineers and planners.

***While we are actively interviewing Junior engineer candidates, we are anticipating the start date of this position to be around June 2027. Official start date to be confirmed with the successful candidate.***

Must be authorized to work in the United States.

As a Junior Civil Engineer, you will support project teams throughout the entitlement, design and construction phases of land development and public infrastructure projects. You’ll work closely with project managers and senior staff on:

* Preparing plans, calculations, and technical reports

* Grading, drainage, water, and sewer design

* Stormwater management and modeling

* Supporting entitlement and permitting processes

* Drafting and plan production using AutoCAD Civil 3D

* Collaborating with clients, agencies, and consultants

This role offers the opportunity to build a strong technical foundation while gaining exposure to real-world project development from concept through construction. We are looking for candidates with:

* 0–3 years of civil engineering experience in land development or public infrastructure.

* Working knowledge of civil engineering principles, methods, and terminology.

* Proficiency (or strong interest) in AutoCAD Civil 3D, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook).

* Exposure to stormwater modeling software such as HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS, XP-Storm, or WaterCAD is a plus.

* A collaborative, team-oriented mindset and attention to detail

* EIT certification in California (preferred).

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Software used in this role may include AutoCAD Civil3D, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS, XP-Storm, and WaterCAD. We value a strong work ethic, attention to detail, and team camaraderie. If you are an engineer who thrives in a collaborative, client-focused environment, we encourage you to apply. If you require a reasonable accommodation or would like to apply for this position, please contact opportunities@msce.com or 925-416-1790.

For a complete listing of all our openings, please visit our careers webpage: https://msce.com/careers/

No recruiters.

Few engineering firms match our track record in California. We are one of the largest and most successful privately held civil engineering firms in NorCal, with offices in Pleasanton (SF Bay Area) and Roseville (Sacramento Valley). Consistently listed in the top 500 design firms in the US by the ENR as we successfully integrate engineering, planning, and surveying expertise to get projects built efficiently and cost effectively. Founded in 1953, MacKay & Somps helped drive growth in Northern California after World War II and we continue that same energy today. Our multi-disciplinary teams provide services from entitlements through construction.

jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatics Scientist – AI/ML for Protein Engineering
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

We are seeking a Senior Bioinformatics Scientist specializing in AI-enabled protein design and engineering to help invent the next generation of enzyme reagents that power Illumina sequencing platforms. Working at the intersection of machine learning, structural biology, and protein engineering, you will apply state-of-the-art computational approaches to design enzymes that expand the performance and capabilities of Illumina technologies. The role is based in San Diego. This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of Illumina’s continued growth.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and apply tailored bioinformatics tools and pipelines to design, engineer, and/or discover novel enzymes.
* Apply modern AI approaches, including protein language models, generative design methods, and structure-based machine learning, to predict and optimize enzyme function.
* Evaluate application, development, and implementation of novel computational methods and AI technologies to leverage protein sequence, structure, and/or experimental data for enzyme engineering.
* Create reusable templates, scripts, dashboards, or lightweight applications that allow project teams to run routine analyses and review computational recommendations more efficiently.
* Contribute to standards for data capture, model evaluation, design rationale, and reproducible computational workflows.
* Analyze high-throughput screening and sequencing datasets to guide protein optimization.
Participate in multi-disciplinarily protein engineering projects and interact with engineers, chemists, biophysicists, and protein scientists, to deliver protein variants with desired properties.  

All listed tasks and responsibilities are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional task and responsibilities.

**Requirements:**

* Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD without experience; or equivalent work experience.
* Practical experience developing and applying AI/ML methods to protein and enzyme engineering
* Solid programming skills in at least one of the major programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, R).
* In-depth knowledge of protein sequence or structure modelling, protein-ligand interaction predictions and/or molecular simulations.
* Strong fundamentals in statistical modelling, algorithm design, data analysis, and/or visualization methods.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Collaborative, open and self-aware, team player, and able to rapidly integrate into cross functional teams.
Highly motivated individual with proven ability in thinking innovatively and the proven track record of productive research and development.  

  

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience with foundational AI/ML models and protein language models for protein engineering, including generative protein design, zero-shot variant scoring, supervised learning, model-guided library design, denoising and uncertainty-aware learning, and multi-parameter optimization of protein properties..
* Experience with structure prediction, protein-ligand or enzyme-substrate modeling, molecular dynamics, docking, or biophysical analysis (e.g. Rosetta, Protein MPNN, RFdiffusion, Boltz, Alphafold)
* Experience developing data standards, assay schemas, dashboards, or lightweight tools for experimental scientists.
* Experience with AI agents.
* Deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX
* Large-scale biological data analysis using cloud or high-performance computing environments. Experience with high-performance computing, job schedulers, and/or GPU computing.
* Experience with experiments within protein engineering, e.g. directed-evolution, high-throughput screening.
* Knowledge of best software development practices and code version control, e.g. Git.
* Knowledge of UNIX environment and shell scripting.
* Broad knowledge of bioinformatics, genomics, and/or proteomics database, tools, and/or algorithms.
* Knowledge of biochemistry, enzymology, and/or molecular biology.
* Familiarity with next generation sequencing technologies, tools, and/or workflows.

Should the level or location of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable base pay range may be updated accordingly. The range reflects long‑term growth in the role; therefore, most candidates are hired between the minimum and middle of the range. Placement depends on experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Additionally, all employees are eligible for one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits as innovative as our work, including access to genomics sequencing, family planning, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits, and paid time off.

jobs.title: AI and Data Science Engineer III
jobs.description:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on December 5, 2026  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As an AI and Data Science Engineer III on the Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team, you will be responsible for...  

* Translating business goals into machine learning use cases and model design approaches.
* Performing exploratory data analysis to identify relationships, opportunities to influence outcomes, and cross-channel attribution patterns.
* Applying clustering, sampling, feature transformation, and predictive modeling techniques to develop and refine solutions.
* Building proofs of concept, interpreting model results, and validating that solutions perform as intended.
* Collaborating with clients and cross-functional teams, including analytics and data engineering teams, throughout solution development and delivery.

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:  

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, machine learning, statistics, computer science, or another quantitative field
* 5+ years of industry experience outside of academia applying data science or machine learning methods
* Experience translating business goals into machine learning use cases and model design
* Experience performing exploratory data analysis and developing predictive models
* Ability to travel 30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  
Preferred:  

* Master's degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, machine learning, statistics, computer science, or another quantitative field
* Experience manipulating large marketing data sets and performing extract, transform, and load activities
* Experience with boosted trees, logistic regression, classification techniques, unsupervised models, large language models, or experimental design
* Experience with data sets generated in advertising technology or marketing technology environments
* Experience presenting complex data insights to non-technical audiences
* Experience with deep learning architectures or reinforcement learning

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $137,500 - $193,600.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.  
  
This position is aligned with the Core Talent Model. To view the associated benefit package, please reference this document https://resources.deloitte.com/:b:/r/sites/dnet-tod-us/Shared Documents/Benefits/USBenefitsJourneyCDandETAM.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=pKjS1C .

jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Join the Intuit Customer Success Data Science & Analytics team as the Manager 3 leading Data Foundations. This team builds the governed, compliant data foundation that Intuit's Customer Success analytics and AI capabilities are built on. Metric definitions, clean domain entities, customer journey data products, semantic knowledge layer and the agentic tooling that keeps them healthy. You will lead a team of senior and staff-level data scientists accountable for building the Governed Data Foundation for ICS. This is a hands-on-adjacent people-leadership role. You will set technical direction, own the roadmap and its financial case, grow domain owners, and influence at the Director and VP level. The work spans two halves that must hold together: building data capabilities (consuming models, automating pipeline development and root-cause analysis, generating insights) and building the knowledge layer (understanding the data deeply enough that governed definitions and semantics can be trusted by downstream agents).This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, sets standards that outlast individual projects, and builds both systems and people that scale across teams and business units.

**Responsibilities**

### **Team Leadership & Talent**

* Lead, coach, and grow a team of senior, staff, and principal data scientists; develop domain leads capable of owning a data domain end to end, from source instrumentation through consumption.
* Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, calibration, and promotion advocacy for the team; build and maintain a strong talent pipeline and participate actively in A4A and talent assessment forums.
* Support craft progression across the team and raise the technical bar through review standards, documented best practices, and internal forums.
* Scale yourself through delegation and clear ownership boundaries; role-model an inclusive, high-trust environment that encourages constructive debate.

### **Strategy & Business Outcomes**

* Own the strategic vision, roadmap, success criteria, and financial case for the Data Foundations portfolio, partner with Finance and TPM to quantify and defend impact.
* Develop KPI frameworks that set direction across the organization, applying a "define once, calculate uniformly" metric standardization model across core data domains.
* Apply first-principles thinking to translate Customer Success business strategy into analytical and data-architecture problems at the Business Unit level.
* Combine insights, business acumen, and industry benchmarks to influence cross-functional leaders, represent the team's work in executive forums and organization-wide reviews.

### **Data Foundations & Governance**

* Drive a shift-left approach to data quality by embedding data design into the product development lifecycle so defects are prevented at source rather than cleaned downstream.
* Establish governed clean entities, standardized metric layers, and semantic/knowledge layers as the trusted source of truth for Customer Success data domains.
* Own end-to-end customer journey data products, stitching behavioral clickstream, contact touchpoints, and time-series journeys to pinpoint drop-offs and high-contact moments that drive cost-to-serve.
* Lead compliance and security execution for the organization's data estate by field-level access control, data-access management, and PII minimization against enterprise mandates and hard regulatory deadlines.
* Negotiate and maintain clear ownership boundaries with Data Engineering and PD partners on governed base tables, paved-path platforms, and the graduation of analyst-built assets into managed ownership.

### **AI Capabilities & Automation**

* Lead custom implementations of AI/GenAI capabilities for key business initiatives, in partnership with AI and platform teams.
* Direct the build-out of agentic data tooling for improving productivity and automation like pipeline migration and development agents, automated data-quality detection, and automated root-cause analysis targeting material reductions in downstream failures, detection time, and analyst hours spent on data bug management.
* Guide the team on measurement of AI-native experiences, connecting model performance metrics (cost, latency, accuracy, hallucination) to customer and business outcomes.
* Be a thought partner on build/buy decisions for analytics workflow tooling, and identify where new methodologies should be adopted and standardized across the organization.

**Qualifications**

### **Required**

  

* BS or MS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics/Econometrics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 14+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or data platform work, including 5+ years directly managing data scientists or analytics engineers.
* Demonstrated success leading teams that deliver governed data foundations at enterprise scale metric standardization, domain/entity modeling, data quality programs, or data product ownership.
* Strong hands-on technical foundation in SQL and Python sufficient to set architectural direction, review your team's work critically, and remain credible in deep technical discussions. This role requires a leader who has coded and can still read code, not one who has moved fully into administration.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and pipeline orchestration, and with migrating legacy analytics estates onto governed, paved-path platforms.
* Proven track record building AI/GenAI or agentic capabilities that automate data operations like validation, quality monitoring, root-cause analysis, or insight generation.
* Demonstrated ability to define metrics that shape business strategy and to influence Director- and VP-level stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience owning a multi-million-dollar impact portfolio, including building the financial case and reporting against it in executive forums.

###

jobs.description:
Overview:

**Overview**

AlivaMab Biologics is seeking an outstanding individual to join the Antibody Discovery Team. The successful candidate will serve as the Research Associate, supporting antibody discovery and screening workflows, enabling identification of antibody hits with therapeutic potential from the AlivaMab® Mouse platform, and contributing to broader technology development and companywide initiatives in collaboration with cross-functional scientific teams, working closely with scientists in Antibody Discovery, Antibody Engineering, and Protein Sciences teams. The successful candidate will be a highly motivated team player and able to multitask in an exciting, fast-paced environment, working to discover the next generation of breakthrough antibody drugs.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform mouse immunizations, sera titer assessment, and tissue collection
* Maintain mammalian cell lines for cell-based assays across multiple projects
* Screen antibodies using ELISA, flow cytometry, and cell-based functional assays
* Prepare reagents and maintain an up-to-date inventory, including monitoring stock levels and reordering as needed
* Demonstrate initiative and creativity in experimental design, execution, and troubleshooting
* Execute high-throughput processes to support antibody discovery and screening workflows using automation
* Effectively maintain meticulous records of lab activities using an electronic notebook (Benchling); communicate findings clearly through written reports and presentations to support project progression and scientific decision-making
* Contribute innovative ideas and collaborate effectively across teams to drive research excellence and project success in a fast-paced environment

Qualifications:

**Qualifications:**

* BS or MS in immunology, cell biology, or related discipline with 0-3 years of relevant industrial or academic experience.
* Small-animal work, including immunization, blood collection, and tissue harvest performed in accordance with IACUC guidelines, is an integral part of this role. Prior hands-on experience with these procedures is an advantage.
* Aseptic mammalian tissue culture experience is required. Demonstrated expertise in culturing cancer cell lines and hybridomas is preferred.
* Ability to work efficiently, both independently and as part of a team, on challenging drug discovery projects that use high-throughput cell culture and antibody screening techniques.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and GraphPad Prism. Experience with Benchling ELN/LIMS is a plus.
* The successful candidate will be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and eager to learn and develop new skills and techniques in antibody drug discovery.
* Experience with stable cell line generation, cell sorting, and/or experimental design of cell-based assays is desired.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills with meticulous attention to detail
* Motivated self-starter with excellent organization, teamwork, and a passion for scientific innovation
* Local candidate preferred. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

**About AlivaMab Biologics**

AlivaMab Biologics sets its partners’ antibody discovery programs on the fastest and most de-risked path through discovery and development. Trusted by top-tier pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, AMB delivers fully human antibodies on exceptional timelines. AMB achieves its partners’ design goals, from simple to extraordinarily challenging, through the generation and function-first screening of large, molecularly diverse panels of antibodies. AMB focuses on the rapid and efficient delivery of antibodies, characterized for function, kinetics, and developability, and on engineering alternative formats, including multispecifics and CARs. The AMB team’s experience and passion for antibody drug discovery and development, combined with trusted, proven technologies, including Ablexis' AlivaMab® Mouse platforms, ensure the highest probability of success.

Want to join a fast-paced, innovative company that is transforming the future of blood testing? Truvian is a healthcare technology company operating at the intersection of diagnostics and consumer technology. We have developed an automated benchtop diagnostic platform that delivers laboratory-quality results in minutes across a broad range of health tests.

jobs.description:
Central to all that California has to offer, Adventist Health Bakersfield has been providing an extraordinary team of world-class physicians, top-notch medical technology, caring professionals and award-winning quality since 1910. We are comprised of a 254-bed acute care hospital and 20 primary and specialty care medical offices. As one of America's fastest growing cities, Bakersfield offers affordable housing on the West Coast, beautiful weather, high-quality education and it is just a few hours away from Yosemite and Sequoia National Parks, the Central California Coast and Southern California's great sports, theaters, concerts and amusement parks.

Job Summary:

Prioritizes and performs a wide variety of clinical laboratory tests on various biological specimens. Reviews, evaluates, documents and reports results. Preserves confidentiality of patients and follows lab safety and maintenance protocols. Trains and supervises trainees, laboratory assistants and clerks as needed.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

* Bachelor’s Degree in medical technology, clinical laboratory science, biological sciences, chemical sciences or allied health technologies or equivalent: Required
* Clinical laboratory experience: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

* Valid Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) license in state of employment: Required in CA
* Current certification from American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or National Credentialing Agency for Labs (NCA): Preferred

Essential Functions:

* Employs positive patient identification procedures to ensure the integrity of each specimen for pre-analytical, analytical and post-analytical testing. Performs proper specimen collection (including phlebotomy procedures as necessary), labeling, handling, preservation or fixation, processing or preparation, transportation and storage. Adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and other patient confidentiality guidelines and regulations.
* Prioritizes lab orders according to type (STAT, ASAP, routine and timed studies) and performs various testing (including chemistry, coagulation, hematology, special chemistry, urinalysis, blood bank, serology, immunology, bacteriology, microbiology, referral testing and more) following prescribed quality assurance policies and procedures. Performs, evaluates and documents quality control checks. Reviews testing results evaluating validity of test results in comparison to anticipated results indicated per procedure manual.
* Reviews and evaluates the validity and accuracy of test results, recognizing the interdependency of tests, the physiological conditions affecting results, patient age and normal values, controls, linearity errors, instrument codes, delta checks and more. Correlates test results with diagnoses and questions incompatible results. Thoroughly documents and communicates test results, expediting all critical values and results to appropriate clinicians.
* Disposes of contaminated materials and equipment in accordance with policy and assures that work area is properly cleansed after each test. Performs equipment and instrumentation maintenance, troubleshooting and calibration as needed. Inventories and restocks reagents, calibrators, controls and supplies as needed.
* Participates in the collection and evaluation of data for Performance Improvement evaluations. Documents adverse events using incident reporting tool. Orients, instructs and supervises laboratory assistants and clerks as needed.
* Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Organizational Requirements:

Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.
  
  
Adventist Health participates in E-Verify. Visit https://adventisthealth.org/careers/everify/ for more information about E-Verify. By choosing to apply, you acknowledge that you have accessed and read the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work notices and understand the contents therein.

This position is appointed through May 2027 and focuses on evaluating the institutional, policy, operational, and community conditions required to establish and sustain a Food as Medicine initiative in Butte County, utilizing North Valley Food Hub (NVFH) infrastructure. The research assistant will work with the project team to analyze healthcare policy and reimbursement pathways, conduct community asset mapping, synthesize food security needs assessments, and support the co-design of a regional FAM pilot program.

To complement this assessment, the assistant will apply systems thinking and community asset mapping methodologies by cataloging local food, healthcare, and social service infrastructure. The Lin Laboratory at USC studies the molecular mechanisms that drive cancer development, progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic response, with a particular focus on head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) and other upper aerodigestive cancers. Our research integrates cancer genomics and epigenomics with functional biology, patient-derived organoid models, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and tumor immunology.

A major strength of the laboratory is the development and application of human organoid models. We use patient-derived tumor organoids and genetically defined organoid systems to reconstruct early malignant transformation, investigate genotype-to-phenotype relationships, model tumor-microenvironment interactions, and identify therapeutic vulnerabilities. The laboratory is embedded within the USC Head and Neck Center and the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, providing a highly collaborative environment with access to clinicians, patient specimens, advanced genomic technologies, and multidisciplinary expertise. **Cancer Genomics • Organoid Biology • Tumor Microenvironment**

  
  

**About the Lin Laboratory**
============================

The Lin Laboratory at USC studies the molecular mechanisms that drive cancer development, progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic response, with a particular focus on head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) and other upper aerodigestive cancers. Our research integrates cancer genomics and epigenomics with functional biology, patient-derived organoid models, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and tumor immunology.

  
  

A major strength of the laboratory is the development and application of human organoid models. We use patient-derived tumor organoids and genetically defined organoid systems to reconstruct early malignant transformation, investigate genotype-to-phenotype relationships, model tumor-microenvironment interactions, and identify therapeutic vulnerabilities. These models are integrated with clinical specimens and multi-omic datasets to address biologically and clinically relevant questions.

  
  

The laboratory is embedded within the USC Head and Neck Center and the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, providing a highly collaborative environment with access to clinicians, patient specimens, advanced genomic technologies, and multidisciplinary expertise. Recent work from the laboratory has included studies of patient-derived HNSCC organoids, tumor immunity, epigenetic regulation, spatial tumor architecture, and mechanisms of metastasis and therapeutic response.

  
  

**Position**
============

We are seeking a motivated Research Associate to join the Lin Laboratory and contribute to NIH-funded studies of cancer biology. The successful candidate will participate in multidisciplinary projects spanning organoid biology, molecular and cellular biology, cancer genomics, tumor immunology, and functional studies of therapeutic response.

This position is particularly well suited for a scientist who wants to work at the interface of experimental and translational cancer research. Depending on experience and interests, projects may involve patient-derived organoid culture and characterization, molecular perturbation, drug-response studies, tumor-immune co-culture, flow cytometry, histology and imaging, and integration of experimental data with single-cell or spatial genomic analyses.

The Lin Laboratory is part of a highly collaborative research community on the USC Health Sciences Campus. The laboratory works closely with investigators in the USC Head and Neck Center, USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, and collaborating institutions. **Company Description**

Eurofins Scientific is a network of independent companies providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

With over 50 laboratories and more than 40 service centers nationwide, Eurofins Environment Testing provides full-service environmental analysis across all 50 states. Our network supports public and private clients—including DoD, DOE, and municipalities—through robust logistics and continuous investment in people, technology, and infrastructure.

We offer comprehensive testing for air, water, soil, sediment, tissue, and waste, covering a wide range of analytes including PFAS, metals, VOCs/SVOCs, dioxins/furans, radiochemicals, and more.

 **Job Description**

Eurofins Environmental Testing Southwest is seeking a Laboratory Technician to join our team in Tustin, CA. This position is ideal for someone who is dependable, hardworking, detail-oriented, and motivated by the opportunity to contribute to environmental testing and protecting the environment.

Previous laboratory or science experience is not required. We are especially interested in candidates with experience in fast paced, production oriented, or hands on work environments who take pride in doing quality work and following established procedures.

The successful candidate will be trained to perform laboratory sample preparation on water, soil and aquatic tissue samples, using established methods and procedures. This role requires someone who can work efficiently, maintain accurate records, safely handle samples and laboratory materials, and consistently meet deadlines and quality requirements.

**Laboratory Technician Responsibilities**

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

* Receive, retrieve, and prepare water, soil and aquatic tissue samples.
* Evaluate workload and prioritize samples based on holding times and due dates.
* Document sample preparation details, observations, and results accurately.
* Prepare reagents and standards for daily use.
* Maintain laboratory equipment.
* Perform routine laboratory duties while following environmental health and safety policies.
* Wash and maintain laboratory glassware as needed.
* Communicate with department managers, analytical teams, and project managers regarding job status, rush requests, sample issues, holding times, and/or other concerns.
* Work efficiently to meet turnaround times and production goals.
* Follow all laboratory SOPs, quality requirements, and company policies.
* Learn and perform new techniques and procedures as training is provided.
* Assist with other laboratory activities as needed.

  
**Qualifications**

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for someone who:

* Is passionate about the environment and interested in contributing to environmental testing.
* Is dependable and takes pride in showing up and doing quality work.
* Has experience working in a fast paced, production oriented environment.
* Can consistently follow detailed instructions and established procedures.
* Is comfortable performing repetitive hands on work while maintaining attention to detail.
* Can work efficiently and meet deadlines without sacrificing quality.
* Is willing and able to learn new techniques and laboratory procedures.
* Works well independently and as part of a team.
* Communicates clearly and professionally.
* Is comfortable working with computers and maintaining accurate records.
* Takes safety seriously and follows workplace safety requirements.
* Is adaptable, self-motivated and has a positive attitude.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Ability to work in a fast paced, hands on environment.
* Ability to stand for extended periods and perform repetitive tasks.
* Ability to lift and handle laboratory samples and materials as required.
* Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.
* Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship

Previous laboratory experience or a degree in chemistry or science is not required. Candidates with experience in fast food, food production, manufacturing, warehouse operations, production environments, or other service oriented and hands on roles are encouraged to apply.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is someone who may not have a traditional science background but has demonstrated that they are:

* Reliable
* Hardworking
* Detail oriented
* Safety conscious
* Able to follow procedures
* Comfortable working in a fast paced environment
* Willing to learn
* A strong team player
* Passionate about environmental stewardship

  
**Additional Information**

**Compensation range**: $18 - $22 per hour depending on experience and qualifications.

* Sunday - Thursday; 1:00pm - 10:00pm

Job Summary:

Prioritizes and performs a wide variety of clinical laboratory tests on various biological specimens. Reviews, evaluates, documents and reports results. Preserves confidentiality of patients and follows lab safety and maintenance protocols. Trains and supervises trainees, laboratory assistants and clerks as needed.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

* Bachelor’s Degree in medical technology, clinical laboratory science, biological sciences, chemical sciences or allied health technologies or equivalent: Required
* Clinical laboratory experience: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

* Valid Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) license in state of employment: Required in CA
* Current certification from American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or National Credentialing Agency for Labs (NCA): Preferred

Essential Functions:

* Employs positive patient identification procedures to ensure the integrity of each specimen for pre-analytical, analytical and post-analytical testing. Performs proper specimen collection (including phlebotomy procedures as necessary), labeling, handling, preservation or fixation, processing or preparation, transportation and storage. Adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and other patient confidentiality guidelines and regulations.
* Prioritizes lab orders according to type (STAT, ASAP, routine and timed studies) and performs various testing (including chemistry, coagulation, hematology, special chemistry, urinalysis, blood bank, serology, immunology, bacteriology, microbiology, referral testing and more) following prescribed quality assurance policies and procedures. Performs, evaluates and documents quality control checks. Reviews testing results evaluating validity of test results in comparison to anticipated results indicated per procedure manual.
* Reviews and evaluates the validity and accuracy of test results, recognizing the interdependency of tests, the physiological conditions affecting results, patient age and normal values, controls, linearity errors, instrument codes, delta checks and more. Correlates test results with diagnoses and questions incompatible results. Thoroughly documents and communicates test results, expediting all critical values and results to appropriate clinicians.
* Disposes of contaminated materials and equipment in accordance with policy and assures that work area is properly cleansed after each test. Performs equipment and instrumentation maintenance, troubleshooting and calibration as needed. Inventories and restocks reagents, calibrators, controls and supplies as needed.

**POSITION SUMMARY:** This research assistant position supports a Food as Medicine (FAM) Feasibility and Pilot Design under an ARI-funded grant at California State University, Chico. This position is appointed through May 2027 and focuses on evaluating the institutional, policy, operational, and community conditions required to establish and sustain a Food as Medicine initiative in Butte County, utilizing North Valley Food Hub (NVFH) infrastructure. The research assistant will work with the project team to analyze healthcare policy and reimbursement pathways, conduct community asset mapping, synthesize food security needs assessments, and support the co-design of a regional FAM pilot program.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** In this role, the research assistant will conduct a population needs and nutrition security assessment, evaluating qualitative and quantitative community health data to identify priority populations and gaps in food security across Butte County. This work will culminate in an authored synthesis report evaluating evidence-based FAM implementation models best suited to address local nutritional needs. To complement this assessment, the assistant will apply systems thinking and community asset mapping methodologies by cataloging local food, healthcare, and social service infrastructure. Utilizing visual systems mapping tools (such as Kumu, ArcGIS, or MindManager), the incumbent will visually diagram resource connections, referral networks, and structural relationships across the regional food-health system.

A core component of the position involves stakeholder collaboration and engagement. The research assistant will participate in structured planning deliberations alongside North Valley Food Hub (NVFH) leadership, regional specialty crop producers, institutional procurement representatives, and healthcare partners to foster cross-sector collaboration and identify community strengths and operational barriers to FAM adoption. Concurrently, the research assistant will undertake a healthcare policy and health equity evaluation, examining local, state, and federal policy landscapes—specifically focusing on Medi-Cal/Medicaid reimbursement pathways, procurement incentives, and funding mechanisms—and authoring a report on how these policy environments impact the long-term sustainability of regional FAM programs.

Finally, integrating findings from across all project phases, the research assistant will apply an ecological lens, social justice values, and evidence-based practices to lead evidence-based program planning and pilot design. The incumbent will draft a comprehensive, practical FAM pilot program plan and operational workflow for the North Valley Food Hub, establishing a scalable framework for institutional Food as Medicine partnerships in Northern California.
